caption: The drawing consists of three separate black ink illustrations on a tan, slightly stained background. At the top left, there is a side view of a rectangular object with a rounded bottom edge, displaying the text “Leonard Ganfvoo” in a serif font. At the top right, there is another side view of a similar object with the text “voort,” also in a serif font, and with a long, thin extension running to the right. Centered below these two objects is a symmetrical, ornate, scrollwork design, possibly a decorative element or crest, with curved and fluted lines. In the bottom left corner, the signature “WELT CO NY” appears in thin, outlined block letters. The page is bordered by faint lines, and there are multiple scattered brown spots and stains.
title: Silver Lemon Strainer
